name: Devpulse Shipping Bar for WooCommerce
author: Devpulse

sections.description:
WooCommerce Smart Cart Notice helps e-commerce store owners increase average order value (AOV) by visually encouraging customers to add more items to their cart to reach the Free Shipping threshold.

Key Features

  • Real-time progress bar calculation with AJAX.
  • Customizable background, text, and gradient progress bar colors.
  • Dynamic cart integration with WooCommerce.
  • Translation ready.
  • Fully responsive and lightweight code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the woo-smart-cart-notice folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Smart Cart Notice to configure your free shipping target and design.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active.
